chat.tamiWelcome:
Hello! I'm **tami**, your safe internet companion. 🐾

Did you encounter a suspicious message, a weird free prize offer, or a confusing online situation? Tell me about it, and let's analyze the clues together!

detector.title: Multimodal Threat Inspector
detector.subtitle: Upload or paste (Ctrl+V) a screenshot of any suspicious message. tami scans for domain anomalies, fake logos, and social engineering traps.
detector.dropzoneHint: or click to browse files from your device (PNG, JPG, WebP max 5MB)
detector.pasteHint: Tip: You can also press Ctrl+V to paste your screenshot directly!
detector.analyzing: tami is inspecting visual & text signals...
detector.zeroStorageNotice: Zero Storage Privacy: Images are processed strictly in RAM and discarded immediately without server persistence.
